name: Notebuddy
tagline: Your own companion, shaped by care, conversation and little adventures.
description:
Turn a drawing or photo into a little companion, or meet a surprise friend. Share your day, care for them and explore together as they grow.

A friend with a personality
Your companion's name and appearance inspire a saved personality, speaking style and small habits. Chat, care reactions and walk stories share that personality. Feeding, playing, resting, training and adventure choices gradually shape how your friend expresses curiosity, sociability, energy and caution. Their identity stays with them as they evolve.

Create and grow together
Start with a ready-made companion, draw on the canvas, or upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo. Anna analyzes visible features and creates an illustrated interpretation. Photos of people, animals and objects can be references. Care helps your companion grow through four stages, and the album keeps the portraits you save along the way.

Small walks, continuing stories
Walks can bring a peaceful moment, an XP discovery or a creature encounter. Choose whether to explore, collect a reward, battle or move on. Six continuing story arcs respond to recorded care and earlier choices, with an explanation of the experiences affecting each outcome. You can close an unfinished walk and return to its saved choice later.

Discover pixel dungeons
Walks may reveal Hellgate, Ice Kingdom or Dream Forest. A discovery lasts 24 hours, and another appears only after it is cleared or expires. Watch your own companion's pixel portrait move through compact rooms and corridors, make safe or risky route choices, and face enemies and a final guardian. Pause or speed up playback when you like. Walk charges recover one every five minutes, up to five; each dungeon stage entry uses one charge.

AI usage and your data
Chat, care replies, walk narration, personality creation, reference-image analysis and portrait generation use your Anna AI allowance. Analyzing a drawing or photo and generating its portrait are separate requests. A random start uses a bundled portrait, while its personality still uses AI. Pixel conversion and dungeon animation do not request AI. Failed AI requests may still use allowance. No separate API key is needed.

English and Korean are available. Your companion, saved artwork, recent chat and shared experiences are kept in your Anna storage. The app includes confirmed reset and saved-data removal controls, with details in the linked privacy notice.

Updated in 0.8.1: dungeons now show the current companion's actual pixel appearance when you replace a character or portrait, alongside the new personality and continuing-walk features.
